description: Yangnyeom Korean Fried Chicken is a beloved dish featuring perfectly crispy chicken coated in a vibrant, sweet, and spicy gochujang-based sauce. This iconic Korean comfort food is known for its irresistible crunch and finger-licking glaze. It's an explosion of flavors that will transport your taste buds straight to the streets of Seoul.

instructions.title: Prepare the Chicken
instructions.text: Pat the chicken pieces very dry with paper towels. Season the chicken all over with salt, black pepper, ginger powder, and garlic powder. Let it sit for 10 minutes while you prepare the batter.

instructions.title: Make the Batter
instructions.text: In a large bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour and cornstarch. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg with 1/2 cup of cold water. Gradually add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients, stirring until a smooth, pancake-like batter forms. Add a little more water if needed to reach the right consistency. Dip each chicken piece into the batter, ensuring it's fully coated.

instructions.title: First Fry the Chicken
instructions.text: Heat the frying oil in a large deep pot or Dutch oven to 350F 175C. Carefully add chicken pieces in batches, making sure not to overcrowd the pot. Fry for 6-8 minutes until light golden and cooked through. Remove chicken with a slotted spoon and place on a wire rack to drain. Bring oil back to temperature between batches.

instructions.title: Prepare the Yangnyeom Sauce
instructions.text: While the chicken drains, combine all sauce ingredients: gochujang, soy sauce, honey or corn syrup, rice vinegar, minced garlic, grated ginger, and sesame oil in a small saucepan. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer over medium-low heat, stirring constantly for 2-3 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly and is well combined. Remove from heat.

instructions.title: Second Fry for Extra Crispiness
instructions.text: Increase the oil temperature to 375F 190C. Fry the chicken a second time in batches for another 2-3 minutes until deep golden brown and extra crispy. This double-frying technique is key for authentic Korean fried chicken texture. Remove and drain on a clean wire rack.

instructions.title: Toss and Serve
instructions.text: In a large bowl, add the freshly fried chicken pieces. Pour the warm Yangnyeom sauce over the chicken and gently toss until every piece is evenly coated. Immediately transfer to a serving platter. Garnish generously with sesame seeds and chopped green onions. Serve hot and enjoy the crispy, saucy goodness!

tips: For the crispiest chicken, ensure your oil temperature is consistent and do not overcrowd the pot during frying. Double frying is crucial for that signature Korean crunch.
Adjust the spice level of the Yangnyeom sauce by increasing or decreasing the amount of gochujang. For extra heat, add a pinch of gochugaru Korean chili flakes.
Yangnyeom chicken is best served immediately after tossing in the sauce to maintain its crispiness. Pair it with pickled radish or a refreshing beer.
